panels.title: Gifford Fig. 6 micrograph, one map for the four legs and their turns

devices.note: Gifford's Fig. 6 schematic is topology only (not to scale), so there is no underlay; the micrograph (the ends of legs 7, 5, 3, 1 and the turns of 5, 3, 1) is placed where its one-map trace registered it.  The preset takes the micrograph's layout (rc6): legs 1, 3, 5, 7 on its rows, legs 2, 4, 6 where semicircular turns about the turn walls' common centre (1745.7 µm beyond leg 1) put them -- only 8-23 degrees of each turn are in the frame, so legs 2, 4, 6 are an assumption; leg 7's array ends 4 rows beyond the image's (LIMITATIONS 25).
